_instructions: Copy only one named input object. Use producer_sustained in the mg-producer-workflow Step Functions execution editor; use count inputs in the mg-producer Lambda test editor. Repeating a run must preserve every input value and the deployed generator code.

_producer_input_help.run_id: Operation-set identity. Reuse the complete input for retry; change run_id for new operations.
_producer_input_help.count: Number of distinct generated operations, from 1 to 10000.
_producer_input_help.duplicate_every: Repeat zero-based indexes divisible by this value. Zero disables intentional duplicates.
_producer_input_help.start_time: First business event timestamp with timezone. Each subsequent event adds one second; sending is not paced to that timestamp.
_producer_input_help.tenant_id: Customer identifier and Kinesis partition key. Must match an existing contract unless verifying quarantine.
_producer_input_help.contract_version: Exact historical contract key. The producer does not supply prices or compute charges.

_sustained_input_help.mode: sustained selects paced multi-customer generation; count retains the fixed-size acceptance inputs.
_sustained_input_help.run_id: Readable run identity using 1..40 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Preserve all settings and generator code for retry; use a fresh identity for new usage.
_sustained_input_help.duration_seconds: Total paced publication seconds across all segments, 1..3600. Default 900 produces at least 15 minutes of traffic plus workflow gaps and any retry delays.
_sustained_input_help.events_per_second: Distinct operations per one-second group, 1..250. Default 200 gives 180000 operations in 900 seconds. Actual throughput can be lower when requests are slow.
_sustained_input_help.duplicate_every: Repeat every Nth zero-based global index; 100 adds 1800 deliberate duplicate deliveries to the default run. Zero disables deliberate duplicates.
_sustained_input_help.start_time: Business timestamp of operation zero, including timezone. Subsequent times advance by index/events_per_second. This may be historical and does not schedule the workflow.
_sustained_input_help.start_second: Internal continuation offset returned in next_input. Do not add it to the first workflow input or edit it manually.
_sustained_input_help.customers: Four fictional customers in lambda/producer.py, with v1 contracts in reference-items.json. Approximately 2% failed requests, zero pages for failures, varied page counts for successes.
